profile.name: DMG-CPU-B
profile.boot: Skipped; bootless profile starts at cartridge entry 0x0100.
profile.applicability: Owned software fixture for the deterministic bootless DMG-CPU-B emulator profile; not physical hardware evidence.
profile.ram_policy: Emulator-defined zero fill; hardware WRAM/HRAM power-up contents are unspecified.

protocol.display_setup: With LCD disabled, the guest writes tile 1 as color number 1 and tile 2 as color number 2, selects BGP identity mapping, places tile 1 at map cell 0, and enables the background.
protocol.initial_expected_image: Shade 1 in pixels x=0..7,y=0..7; shade 0 in every other pixel.
protocol.input: Host queues active-low A press at baseline_time+8 half-dots and release at baseline_time+50008 half-dots; guest polls the action row at FF00.
protocol.visible_response: After detecting press, guest waits for LY>=144 then sets map cell 0 to tile 2; after release, it waits for visible LY<144 and the next LY>=144 before restoring tile 1.
protocol.guest_outcome: WRAM C000 becomes 1 after the press is handled; WRAM C001 becomes 1 after release is observed.

scope_limits: No exact JOYP interrupt or wake behavior claim
No window, object, audio, mapper, save or color hardware claim
The authored expected image and scripted guest outcome are separate from timing and hardware evidence
